notes.title: MONK CHARACTER!
notes.content:
Monk Character has been added
to unlock you would need to defeat the dragon boss.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voidwave/voidwave.github.io/main/img/Monk.jpg

[ENERGY] Monk Passive : 
whenever the monk does physical damage he fills up his energy bar, making his dashes shoot electric projectiles that can apply onhit effects.

KnockBack on [3rd Attack].
____________________________________

[Shield Regen] Berserker Passive : 
Moved the Shield Perks to be Berserker only, and gave him the Shield Regen Perk as a Passive.
and starts with 2 points of shield.
Extra Physical Damage on [3rd Attack].
